record.reason: NativeTernary encodes ternary weights and structure; a BitNet b1.58 2B example estimates 91-byte boundary metadata vs about 42KB GGUF headers. Benchmarks are assumption-based/single-core synthetic, with checkpoint validation planned. It reduces format/header overhead, not inference compute/runtime memory; weak serving relation.
record.title: NativeTernary: A Self-Delimiting Binary Encoding with Unary Run-Length Hierarchy Markers for Ternary Neural Network Weights, Structured Data, and General Computing Infrastructure
